paragraphs: R. Yeshayah, R. Ḥanina ben Dosa's student, fasted eighty-eight fasts over why the dog merited singing 'Come, let us bow down.' The angel answered him: 'Were you not a great man's student,' etc. Yalkut, Bo, §187. (In my work I wrote a sound reason for the eighty-eight fasts.)
